# Check: parse_args() with no argument defaults to sys.argv[1:]
import sys
sys.argv = ['pysemver']  # simulate bare invocation
from semver import createparser
p = createparser()
args = p.parse_args()  # no args specified - uses sys.argv[1:]
print(f"args.which = {getattr(args, 'which', 'MISSING')}")
print(f"vars(args) = {vars(args)}")
